```{r}
#| results: asis
resources <- withCallingHandlers(
  read.csv("resources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
           fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = character()),
  warning = function(w) stop(conditionMessage(w), call. = FALSE)
)
stopifnot(all(c("Topics", "Format") %in% names(resources)))

escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
category_counts <- function(values) {
  parts <- lapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(values), "", values), ";", fixed = TRUE),
                  function(x) unique(trimws(x)))
  all <- unlist(parts)
  sort(table(all[nzchar(all)]), decreasing = TRUE)
}
topics <- category_counts(resources$Topics)
formats <- category_counts(resources$Format)
icons <- c(
  "article / book" = '<path d="M12 7v14M3 4h4a5 5 0 0 1 5 3 5 5 0 0 1 5-3h4v15h-4a5 5 0 0 0-5 2 5 5 0 0 0-5-2H3z"/>',
  "report" = '<path d="M5 3h9l5 5v13H5zM14 3v6h5M8 13h8M8 17h8"/>',
  "video" = '<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="m10 9 5 3-5 3z"/>',
  "podcast" = '<path d="M3 14v-3a9 9 0 0 1 18 0v3"/><rect x="3" y="12" width="4" height="7" rx="2"/><rect x="17" y="12" width="4" height="7" rx="2"/>',
  "website" = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="4" ry="9"/><path d="M3 12h18"/>',
  "art" = '<path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18h2a2 2 0 0 0 1-4 2 2 0 0 1 1-4h3a2 2 0 0 0 2-2 9 9 0 0 0-9-8z"/><path d="M7 10h.1M11 7h.1M16 8h.1M7 15h.1" stroke-width="3"/>',
  "museum / exhibit" = '<path d="m3 8 9-5 9 5zM5 10v8M10 10v8M14 10v8M19 10v8M3 21h18"/>',
  "infographic" = '<path d="M4 3v17h17M8 16v-5M13 16V6M18 16v-8"/>',
  "map" = '<path d="m3 6 6-3 6 3 6-3v15l-6 3-6-3-6 3zM9 3v15M15 6v15"/>',
  "indigenous science" = '<path d="M20 4C8 3 3 9 5 16c7 5 15-1 15-12zM4 21 15 10"/>',
  "california native history" = '<path d="m3 8 9-5 9 5zM5 10v8M10 10v8M14 10v8M19 10v8M3 21h18"/>',
  "indigenous education" = '<path d="M12 7v14M3 4h4a5 5 0 0 1 5 3 5 5 0 0 1 5-3h4v15h-4a5 5 0 0 0-5 2 5 5 0 0 0-5-2H3z"/>',
  "decolonization" = '<path d="M3 4h18v12H9l-6 5zM7 8h10M7 12h7"/>',
  "tribal university partnerships" = '<circle cx="8" cy="7" r="3"/><circle cx="16" cy="7" r="3"/><path d="M2 21v-3a6 6 0 0 1 12 0v3M14 13a6 6 0 0 1 8 5v3"/>'
)
icon <- function(label) {
  path <- icons[tolower(label)]
  if (is.na(path)) path <- icons["report"]
  paste0('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">', path, '</svg>')
}
descriptions <- c(
  "California Native History" = "Regional histories and Indigenous perspectives.",
  "Indigenous Education" = "Scholarship on science education and land-based learning.",
  "Decolonization" = "Introductory talks, reflections and critical perspectives.",
  "Indigenous Science" = "Indigenous knowledge systems, science and environmental stewardship.",
  "Tribal University Partnerships" = "Relationships and collaboration between Tribal communities and universities."
)
cat('<section class="home-hero" aria-labelledby="home-intro"><p class="home-eyebrow">Learning · Teaching · Relationships</p><h2 id="home-intro">Explore, learn, and build respectful relationships</h2><p>This developing collection brings together publicly discoverable resources on Indigenous histories, education, science, and decolonization. It is intended as a starting point for educators, researchers, and community partners—not as a substitute for relationships with Indigenous communities or community-specific guidance.</p><a class="home-primary" href="library.html">Explore the resource library →</a><p class="home-count"><strong>', nrow(resources), '</strong> resources · ', length(topics), ' topics · ', length(formats), ' formats</p></section>', sep="")
cat('<section class="home-section" aria-labelledby="home-topics"><h2 id="home-topics">Explore by topic</h2><p>Find a starting point for your learning.</p><div class="home-topic-grid">')
for (label in names(topics)) {
  desc <- descriptions[label]
  if (is.na(desc)) desc <- "Explore resources in this topic."
  cat('<a class="home-topic" href="library.html?topic=', URLencode(label, reserved=TRUE), '">', icon(label), '<h3>', escape(label), '</h3><p>', escape(desc), '</p><span class="home-link-label">', topics[[label]], ' resources →</span></a>', sep="")
}
cat('</div></section><section class="home-section" aria-labelledby="home-formats"><h2 id="home-formats">Browse by resource format</h2><div class="home-format-grid">')
for (label in names(formats)) {
  cat('<a class="home-format" href="library.html?format=', URLencode(label, reserved=TRUE), '">', icon(label), '<strong>', escape(label), '</strong><span>', formats[[label]], ' resources</span></a>', sep="")
}
cat('</div><p class="home-note">Resources may appear in more than one topic or format.</p></section>')
```

::: {.home-stewardship}
## About this pilot

This is an early prototype built from a small working inventory. Resource descriptions, categories, permissions, and the site's future direction are subject to review with the Indigenous scholars helping curate the collection.

[Learn about stewardship and contributions →](about.qmd)
:::
